---
title: "Teaching"
---

I teach statistics for psychology students and have supported a range of courses
in psychology and cognitive science as a teaching assistant.

## As instructor

```{=html}
<div class="teaching">
  <div class="course-entry">
    <div class="body">
      <div class="course-title">Statistics for the Behavioral Sciences</div>
      <div class="course-details">PSYCH-UA.10 · Department of Psychology, New York University</div>
      <div class="course-description">
        An introduction to statistics for psychology majors: evaluating data from
        different kinds of studies, statistical prediction, and applying statistical
        reasoning to decision making. Students learn to analyze data in R and write
        up results in APA format, working through data description, variability,
        significance tests, confidence intervals, tests of differences of means,
        correlation, linear regression, and nonparametric methods.
      </div>
      <div class="course-role">Role: Instructor</div>
      <ul class="course-semesters">
        <li class="no-link">Summer 2025</li>
        <li class="no-link">Summer 2026</li>
      </ul>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
```
